gt.description: Enforces decimal to be greater than the set value

ge.description: Enforces decimal to be greater than or equal to the set value

lt.description: Enforces decimal to be less than the set value

le.description: Enforces decimal to be less than or equal to the set value

max_digits.description: Maximum number of digits within the decimal. it does not include a zero before the decimal point or trailing decimal zeroes

decimal_places.description: Max number of decimal places allowed. it does not include trailing decimal zeroes

multiple_of.description: Enforces decimal to be a multiple of the set value
